description: Products Rabbit already knows sell, with their price: `ideas` (this week’s picks, filterable by words, niche and budget), `best_sellers` (1688’s best sellers for a country) or `priced` (products Rabbit has fully priced) or `catalog` (Rabbit’s whole screened catalog, filtered by their needs and budget — category, budget per piece, minimum order, new models from verified manufacturers, beginner-friendly — with the total, pages and the categories that exist). A fallback when you cannot research trends on the web yourself.

beginner.description: With catalog: true for beginner-friendly products only.

category.description: With catalog: a category returned in `familles`.

count.description: With best_sellers: how many (10 if omitted).

country.description: The country, as a two-letter code (US, FR, GB…); their account’s if omitted.

max_minimum_order.description: With catalog: the highest minimum order they accept, in pieces.

max_price_per_piece.description: With ideas: their budget per piece.

new_only.description: With catalog: true for new models from manufacturers verified on 1688 only.

niche.description: With ideas: a category (home, kitchen, fashion, wellness, sport, tech, phone, jewelry, pets, baby, car, tools, gadgets).

page.description: With catalog: the page (1 if omitted).

per_page.description: With catalog: products per page (20 if omitted, 50 at most).

sort.description: With catalog: most ordered first (if omitted), or by price.

words.description: With ideas: the item they look for, in plain words (“dog harness”).

name: trending_products
title: What sells on 1688
